purpose: Add independent benchmark alignment, descriptive return-attribution, and asset-level diagnostics to the completed provisional H01/H04 result without changing a candidate parameter, creating a candidate, opening a holdout, or authorizing execution.

market_reference.description: SPY adjusted-close daily return as a total-return proxy; adjustment availability and construction remain unverified.

cash_plus_equity.description: Daily-rebalanced 60% SPY adjusted-return proxy and 40% zero-return cash. It is not a cash-rate benchmark because no point-in-time rate input is admitted.

volatility_matched.description: Causally scaled equal-weight basket using the same declared trailing-window, target, and cap conventions as the H04 candidate.

attribution.limitation: The bridge is descriptive and non-additive. It is not a formal factor model, a causal attribution, or a source of candidate retuning.

asset_level.candidate_sleeve: For each asset, apply the fixed parent H01 direction and H04 multiplier to that asset's next daily adjusted-close return without the parent portfolio's 1/N weight. Compare only as a diagnostic against that asset's buy-and-hold adjusted-price proxy.

data_adjustment_boundary.required_interpretation: Adjusted closes may retrospectively incorporate distributions or splits whose availability timing is not retained. The diagnostic must label this potential leakage and must not assert that adjusted-close inputs were usable at the simulated decision time.

forbidden_actions: modify parent candidate parameters, universe, folds, costs, or return timing
create, retrieve, seal, approve, or open a holdout
claim alpha, a strategy grade, statistical significance, or investability
evaluate options or create paper or live orders
